description: Odds that dropped the most from opening at sharp bookmakers, with drop percentages since opening and over 12h, 24h and 48h. Refreshed every few seconds. Paid plans. For player prop markets, market.label holds the player name. Always pass sport when the user mentions or implies one: without it results are dominated by player props.

includeEventDetails.description: Include teams, date, sport and league for each row

league.description: Single league slug. Requires sport. Mutually exclusive with leagues

leagues.description: Comma-separated league slugs (e.g. 'england-premier-league,spain-laliga'). Mutually exclusive with league

markets.description: Comma-separated market names, case-insensitive. Supported: ML, Spread, Totals, Spread HT, Totals HT, Totals 1Q, Spread 1Q, Team Total Home, Team Total Away, First 5 Innings ML, First 5 Innings Spread, First 5 Innings Totals, Corners Spread, Corners Totals, Corners Spread HT, Corners Totals HT, Bookings Spread, Bookings Totals, Player Props ('Player Props' covers every player prop market)

sort.description: drop (highest drop %, default), recent (latest movement) or kickoff (soonest event)

sport.description: Sport slug (e.g. 'football'). Always include it when the user mentions a sport

timeWindow.description: Window for drop filtering and sorting (default 'opening')

name: get_dropping_odds
title: Dropping odds
